cards.card_text: The LORD says the redemption money goes to ___ and his ___.
cards.verse_text: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.”
cards.snippet: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.”

cards.card_text: Moses collects the redemption money from all 22,273 of Israel's firstborn.
cards.verse_text: So Moses collected the redemption money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.
cards.snippet: So Moses collected the redemption money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.

cards.card_text: The man tells Boaz, "Take my right of redemption, because I cannot redeem it." And just like that, the door swings wide open for Boaz.
cards.verse_text: Take my right of redemption, because I cannot redeem it.”
cards.snippet: Take my right of redemption, because I cannot redeem it.”

cards.card_text: The redemption of a soul is costly, and no payment would ever be enough.
cards.verse_text: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
cards.snippet: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,

cards.verse_text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
cards.snippet: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome…

cards.card_text: Loving devotion and redemption are with Him Their enemies have already been defeated Their harvest will be bigger than ever
cards.verse_text: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
cards.snippet: …LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.

cards.card_text: Along with the day of vengeance, the One from Edom says the year of His redemption was still far off.
cards.verse_text: For the day of vengeance was in My heart, and the year of My redemption had come.
cards.snippet: …day of vengeance was in My heart, and the year of My redemption had come.

cards.card_text: The LORD says Jeremiah's cousin Hanamel will ask him to buy his field, since Jeremiah has the right of redemption.
cards.verse_text: Hanamel, the son of your uncle Shallum, is coming to you to say, ‘Buy for yourself my field in Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it.’
cards.snippet: …for yourself my field in Anathoth, for you have the right of redemption to buy it.’

cards.card_text: Hanamel URGES Jeremiah to buy his field in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin, since Jeremiah owns the right of inheritance and redemption.
cards.verse_text: Then, as the LORD had said, my cousin Hanamel came to me in the courtyard of the guard and urged me, ‘Please buy my field in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin, for you own the right of inheritance and redemption.
cards.snippet: …the land of Benjamin, for you own the right of inheritance and redemption.

cards.card_text: Everyone waiting for Jerusalem's redemption The priests serving in the temple The women from the tribe of Asher
cards.verse_text: Coming forward at that moment, she gave thanks to God and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: …and spoke about the Child to all who were waiting for the redemption of Jerusalem.

cards.verse_text: When these things begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”
cards.snippet: …begin to happen, stand up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is drawing near.”

cards.card_text: This is FREE, through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus, whom God presented as an atoning sacrifice in His blood through faith.
cards.verse_text: and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.
cards.snippet: and are justified freely by His grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus.

cards.card_text: The redemption of their bodies A rest from all their labor A home in the promised land
cards.verse_text: Not only that, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.
cards.snippet: …groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our adoption as sons, the redemption of our bodies.

cards.card_text: And Christ has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
cards.verse_text: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus, who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.
cards.snippet: …who has become for us wisdom from God: our righteousness, holiness, and redemption.

cards.verse_text: He did not enter by the blood of goats and calves, but He entered the Most Holy Place once for all by His own blood, thus securing eternal redemption.
cards.snippet: …Holy Place once for all by His own blood, thus securing eternal redemption.
